test_Portal_copy_device_transfer: test the Portal class copy method to transfer a tensor from CPU to CUDA device
test_Portal_blue_orange_grad: test the Portal blue and orange methods for correct gradient computation with fork and join
test_Portal_blue_orange_no_grad: test the Portal blue and orange methods when the tensor does not require gradients
test_Portal_put_grad_use_grad: test the Portal put_grad and use_grad methods for ephemeral gradient storage and retrieval
test_Portal_tensor_life_lifecycle: test the Portal tensor_life parameter to control how many blue and orange operations exhaust the tensor
